notes.title: Hope's Farm 2 - Update 0.133- Freshly Harvested Improvements!
notes.notes:
Howdy Farmers!

Thanks a bushel for your amazing feedback and for helping us keep Hope's Farm running smoothly with your bug reports and suggestions!

What's New on the Farm:

 We've plowed over those language barriers! Now, our international farmers can easily select their preferred language in the Options menu – happy farming to everyone! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438536/27a230764a6dbe97353af7b0a6eabbbb06542b72.png
 Other bug fixes and improvements.

Thanks for being such a fantastic community! Keep on planting, matching, and having a barn-load of fun in Hope's Farm 2!

Don't wait! Version 0.133 is available now – let the farming fun continue!
